about: Real days the game notices (CalendarRules, docs/dev/unity-port.md section 9f). md is MM-DD on the player's local calendar. On a day: a stamp on the Lobby (tap it: the gift, once a year) and her line, by her faction. player_birthday: the player's own day, if they gave it on the intake form ({name} is theirs). Birthdays: each heroine's day, for owned heroines only; the Lobby heroine says 'mine' on her own and names the other one ({her}) on someone else's. Lines are short: the Lobby sets them huge.

lines.celestial: A new year. I wrote you into every page of it.
lines.infernal: New year, same sins. Let's add a few.
lines.fallen: Another year. I'm still here. So are you.

lines.celestial: I wrote you a hymn. Please don't read it aloud.
lines.infernal: Valentine's Day. I don't do chocolates. I do worse.
lines.fallen: I'm bad at Valentine's Day. Stay anyway.

lines.celestial: I came as an angel. Nobody believes it's a costume.
lines.infernal: Halloween. The one night nobody stares at the horns.
lines.fallen: Everyone wears a mask tonight. I can take mine off.

lines.celestial: Heaven's busiest night. I stayed here with you.
lines.infernal: Christmas Eve. I've been very naughty. Check the list.
lines.fallen: Nobody hangs a stocking for the Fallen. Except you.

lines.celestial: Merry Christmas, envoy. Unwrap me carefully.
lines.infernal: Merry Christmas. I wrapped myself. Mostly.
lines.fallen: Merry Christmas. My first in a long time.

lines.celestial: The last night of the year. Stay up with me.
lines.infernal: Midnight's coming. Decide who you're kissing.
lines.fallen: One more year survived. Raise a glass with me.

lines.celestial: Happy birthday, {name}. I asked heaven to sing this morning.
lines.infernal: Happy birthday, {name}. Make a wish. I'll handle the wicked ones.
lines.fallen: Happy birthday, {name}. I kept your form. I knew today was coming.

mine.celestial: It's my birthday. You came. That's the gift.
mine.infernal: My birthday, envoy. I expect to be spoiled.
mine.fallen: My birthday. I stopped counting. Count this one.

other.celestial: It's {her}'s birthday. Go and say something kind.
other.infernal: {her}'s birthday. She'll pretend she doesn't care.
other.fallen: {her}'s birthday today. Don't make a fuss. A small one.
